response.sql: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, AVG(CASE WHEN spent <> 0 AND amount <> 0 THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount END) AS avg_relative_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count FROM category_stats) SELECT AVG(cs.avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(cs.line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count, AVG(cs.line_count - o.avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_line_count FROM category_stats AS cs CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE cs.line_count > o.avg_line_count;
